rows.text: The medical treatment of inorganic beings has always been a confounding conundrum for Doctors of Chaos. These metal creations have neither the cells to allow for potions to take effect nor the brains that can react to rituals. To eliminate Nihility's taint on their rust and circuits, the doctors ground silicon-eating flowers to dust, then combine them with secretions of comet cicadas and fingernails of roaming devils to create a powerful spiritual lubricant. Though Intellitrons lack taste sensors and do not complain about the taste of potions and ointments unlike organic life, patients indicate that all Intellitrons who have had the lubricant added to them have reported dreams of an electric butterfly with a gaping, bloody jaw.
